mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.email, u.password, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.avatar_url, u.role, s.student_id, s.enrollment_year FROM users u INNER JOIN students s ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{userId}
SELECT u.id, u.email, u.password, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.avatar_url, u.role, s.student_id, s.enrollment_year FROM users u INNER JOIN students s ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE u.email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO students (user_id, student_id, enrollment_year) VALUES (#{id}, #{studentId}, #{enrollmentYear})
